fresh.title: Pros and Cons of Self-hosting a Public Git Forge
fresh.summary: It's been over a year since I mostly broke up with GitHub . In that year, I've been running my own public Forgejo instance for my personal projects. It's important to stress the public part, as most of what I'm going to discuss is directly correlated to that. This isn't a post to critique Forgejo vs. alternatives, either. I found Forgejo to be great. My only gripe is that I very much prefer GitLab

fresh.title: Prop. 4 clears a path for public campaign money. It does not spend any.
fresh.summary: Proposition 4 would lift California's ban on public financing of campaigns and leave the size of any future program to later governments.

fresh.title: Ring is deliberately nefarious when you E2E encrypt your video
fresh.summary: I turned on Ring's End-to-End Encryption for a bit more privacy. Previews vanished, recordings broke and answering the door stopped working. Here's what happened.
